name: Butternut Squash "Jack-O'-Lantern" Quesadillas with Avocado-Lime Crema

instructions.primary_message: Place butternut squash on a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and chili powder; toss with your hands to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups frozen butternut squash, pieces
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until squash is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

While the squash is baking, coat a large baking sheet with a thin layer of oil. Arrange 6 tortillas on the baking sheet, placing them at least 1-inch apart from each other. (Reserve remaining 6 tortillas for the next step.)
Working one at a time, place remaining tortillas on a cutting board; using a sharp paring knife, cut away pieces of tortilla to create a "jack-o'-lantern" design. Set aside.
Grate cheddar into a medium bowl.
When the squash is done, use a fork to roughly mash it. Transfer squash to the bowl with the cheddar; using the fork, mash and combine the cheesy squash filling.
Divide filling (a slightly heaping ¼-cup) between tortillas on the baking sheet, spreading it out in an even layer, about a ½-inch from the edges.
Place a "jack-o'-lantern" tortilla on top of each filled tortilla, gently pressing the two together to seal. Using a pastry brush, brush the tops with additional oil.

Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until quesadillas are golden and cheese filling is melted and warmed through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven. (The filling may puff up slightly in the oven but will deflate as the quesadillas cool.)
While the quesadillas are baking, wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and roughly chop. Place in a blender.

Wash, dry, and juice lime into the blender. Add sour cream, cold water, and spices. Blend on high until smooth, adding additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach desired consistency.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lime
½ cup sour cream
2 tbsp water
½ tsp salt
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
⅛ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Serve warm squash quesadillas with avocado crema on the side. Enjoy!
